opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, travelers, cabin)
opportunities.description: Search United.com for flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date}/{return_date} with given trip type, travelers, cabin, and award option, then optionally pick a fare.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight form
Set trip type (Roundtrip/One-way) and optionally check 'Book with miles'
Type origin city and pick the airport suggestion
Type destination city and pick the airport suggestion
Open the Depart date picker, navigate months, pick depart (and return) dates
Optionally open Travelers and adjust adult/child counts
Optionally change cabin class
Click Find flights
Optionally pick a fare from results

instances.values: One-way, book with miles, Sacramento SMF -> Houston IAH, Jun 2
Roundtrip, Baltimore BWI -> New York NYC, Aug 2-Aug 7, 2 adults
Roundtrip, Pune PNQ -> New York NYC, Jun 9-Jun 11, selected Economy fully refundable $2,984
Roundtrip, Mumbai BOM -> London LON, Jul 1-Jul 5, 2 adults + 1 child (12-14), Premium economy
One-way, Springfield SPI -> Austin AUS, date changed to Apr 29, viewed details/seats
Roundtrip, Santa Fe SAF -> Phoenix PHX, Aug 13-Aug 28, selected $681 Economy

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search with filter
opportunities.description: Search Tripadvisor Restaurants in {location} and apply a {filter} such as cuisine, dietary restriction, or feature.
steps: Click Restaurants on the Tripadvisor home page
Type the location in the 'Where to?' search box
Pick the matching location suggestion
Optionally click 'More restaurants in…' or 'Show more' in the filter section
Check the filter (cuisine/dietary/feature) and click Apply if a modal opens

instances.values: Central Park New York, Italian cuisine
Los Angeles, Indian cuisine; limited search to LA, opened Urban Masala, saved to new trip 'Los Angeles'

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: Find parking on SpotHero near {venue} for {event}, optionally filtering (e.g. wheelchair accessible), adjusting entry/exit times, and sorting.
steps: Type the venue in 'Search for parking'
Pick the venue suggestion
Optionally pick the event date in the events modal
Pick the event
Optionally click Filter, check amenities, and click Show N Results
Optionally change the Start/End time and click Update Search
Optionally change the sort order or click Book Now

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets, 3:00-5:00 PM, Book Now on 201 S Portland Ave

opportunities.name: United map search for destinations
opportunities.description: Use United's 'Explore destinations' map search from {origin} with trip type and flexible dates.
steps: Open the map search (BOOK > Map search)
Type the origin in 'Flying from' and pick the airport
Set trip type and dates (Flexible dates)
Click Search
Optionally view the list of results or a destination
